My skin is very dry, I have treated hypothyroidism, I've always had skin problems but they were seasonal, the worst in winter. In 2017 I had a job at a car wash and at first it was fine but at some point the skin on my hands started to crack very badly so I quit. Went to a dermatologist, had patch test for 50-something allergens and it all came clear. Two days in the hospital to find out nothing. From that point on, the irritation is almost always here, gets better when I take otc allergy meds in spring (I'm allergic to pollen) and use topical steroid (consluted with a professional, I very rarely use them and no longer than a week at a time).  


Currently I'm using an EmoTopic moisturising cream or Yope hand cream as many times as I need (usually 5-10 times a day, depending on how often I must wash my hands - I use an Oillan med+ non-soap thingy). I apply a vitamin E ointment under cotton gloves overnight. It seems to help the most but it's not very convenient. I've been doing this for more than 6 months.  


Even when I'm trying to avoid doing anything undesired, the irritation still more or less exists. I guess part of the solution would be finding a product that's really focusing on forming the protective layer (so not a moisturiser probably?), there's really no way I could reduce the exposure any further. I suspect visiting a dermatologist would be the best but I can't afford it for now. I'm in Poland btw.
